nodes.name: Avesta
nodes.label: Avesta
nodes.description: Sacred texts of Zoroastrianism containing the Gathas attributed to Zoroaster and liturgical compositions.

nodes.name: Gathas of Zoroaster
nodes.label: Gathas of Zoroaster
nodes.description: Oldest Avestan hymns attributed directly to Zoroaster, expressing foundational theological concepts.

nodes.name: Behistun Inscription
nodes.label: Behistun Inscription
nodes.description: Trilingual inscription of Darius I on cliff face recording his rise to power and conquests.

nodes.name: Persepolis Administrative Tablets
nodes.label: Persepolis Administrative Tablets
nodes.description: Archive of Elamite cuneiform tablets documenting Achaemenid imperial administration.

nodes.name: Bundahishn
nodes.label: Bundahishn
nodes.description: Zoroastrian encyclopedic text on cosmogony, mythology, and world history compiled in late antiquity.

nodes.name: Shahnameh (Book of Kings)
nodes.label: Shahnameh
nodes.description: Ferdowsi's epic poem recounting Persian mythological and historical kings, foundational to Iranian identity.

nodes.name: Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam
nodes.label: Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam
nodes.description: Collection of quatrains attributed to the mathematician-poet exploring themes of mortality and pleasure.

nodes.name: Masnavi of Rumi
nodes.label: Masnavi of Rumi
nodes.description: Spiritual epic poem by Rumi, called 'the Quran in Persian,' teaching Sufi mysticism through stories.

nodes.name: Divan of Hafez
nodes.label: Divan of Hafez
nodes.description: Collected ghazals of Hafez, beloved for their mystical ambiguity and literary perfection.

nodes.name: Alam-ara-yi Abbasi
nodes.label: Alam-ara-yi Abbasi
nodes.description: Official chronicle of Shah Abbas I's reign, key source for Safavid history.

nodes.name: Safavid Royal Manuscripts
nodes.label: Safavid Royal Manuscripts
nodes.description: Illuminated manuscripts produced in Safavid royal workshops combining calligraphy and miniature painting.

nodes.name: Persian Constitution of 1906
nodes.label: Persian Constitution of 1906
nodes.description: Iran's first constitution establishing parliamentary government and fundamental rights.

nodes.name: The Blind Owl
nodes.label: The Blind Owl
nodes.description: Sadegh Hedayat's modernist novel exploring alienation and obsession, landmark of Persian literature.

nodes.name: Poetry of Nima Yushij
nodes.label: Poetry of Nima Yushij
nodes.description: Revolutionary free verse poetry breaking from classical forms, founding modern Persian poetry.

nodes.name: Iranian Constitution of 1979
nodes.label: Iranian Constitution of 1979
nodes.description: Foundational document of the Islamic Republic establishing velayat-e faqih governance.

nodes.name: Reading Lolita in Tehran
nodes.label: Reading Lolita in Tehran
nodes.description: Azar Nafisi's memoir about secret literature classes in post-revolutionary Iran.

nodes.name: Persepolis
nodes.label: Persepolis
nodes.description: Marjane Satrapi's autobiographical graphic novel depicting childhood during the Islamic Revolution.
